finite_semantic_example.scope: At least3 semantic symbols, thus2 fixed noiseless bits, for this predeclared finite goal alphabet and common sensor history; no universal bit lower bound claimed.

negative_control.limit: Position tolerance alone does not certify that an arbitrarily small intended motion actually occurred.

target_precision.scope: Counterexample to deriving the original goal tolerance from the tracking tube alone after quantization; not a simulated physical plant failure.

optional_command_bit_error_model.scope: Additional bounded command-corruption model, not part of the original noisy-observation task.

evidence: Exact finite enumeration and rational interval arithmetic; no kernel or physical validation.
